rule.text:
Hold the line as PRICE_VAR. The excess is ₹5 per unit on 500 units, ₹2,500 in total. The limit is the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500 [1]: 1% of ₹1,97,500 is ₹1,975, so the cap of ₹500 applies. ₹2,500 is above ₹500.

Send it to the buyer who raised the PO to amend the PO or obtain a credit note [1][2]. The PO buyer has 3 working days to resolve it [2].

citations.quote: The line passes only if the total excess on that line is no more than the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500. A line that fails is held with exception PRICE_VAR and sent to the buyer who raised the PO.
PRICE_VAR · Unit price above tolerance (4.2) · PO buyer · 3 working days
A good note: 'Line 2 cement, invoice ₹412 per bag vs PO ₹395, excess ₹8,500 on 500 bags, above the ₹500 limit. Please amend PO or get a credit note.'

decision: Hold the line — price variance above tolerance
next_owner: PO buyer (amend PO or credit note)

expert_tip.text: Write the exception note so the buyer can act without calling you: the line, both prices, the excess and the limit, and what you need from them.
expert_tip.author: Sandeep Rao, Team Lead
